description.value:
The Battlemind archetype channels the Consular's mastery of the Force inward as much as outward, fusing psychic combat technique with martial awareness. Rather than standing at the back of a fight lobbing powers from range, the Battlemind Consular wades into melee protected by a shroud of telekinetic force, turning their own body into a conduit for devastating, close-quarters Force expression.

Battleminds develop the knack of projecting Force barriers around themselves mid-fight, lashing out with force-augmented strikes, and reading the intentions of nearby minds — making them equally capable of a quiet negotiation and a sudden, overwhelming show of power.
